name: Asato Sara
source:
The second youngest sister in family. Has always had a weak constitution thus was doted on by brother and tend to get away with most things. Takes pleasure in teasing/messing with her brother.

[spoiler] Due to poor health was believed by dr. she wasn't going to have long life. But after receiving recent news that she was in great health compared to before reevaluated life and view on her brother. She also has an incredible "don". She can go into "moe mode personality" which makes all her siblings in siscon mode.[/spoiler]
